Title: CVE-2023-4966 - Citrix NetScaler ADC / Gateway Information Disclosure (Citrix Bleed)
Raw_Content: CVE-2023-4966: Sensitive information disclosure in NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway when configured as a Gateway or AAA virtual server across versions 13.0 before 13.0-92.21, 13.1 before 13.1-49.15, and 14.1 before 14.1-8.50. Unauthenticated remote attackers can extract session tokens from uninitialized memory buffers via buffer over-read in OpenID configuration endpoints, completely bypassing multi-factor authentication (MFA). Actively exploited in the wild as a zero-day.

Title: CVE-2023-22515 - Atlassian Confluence Server & Data Center Broken Access Control
Raw_Content: CVE-2023-22515: Critical broken access control flaw in Atlassian Confluence Data Center and Server versions 8.0.0 through 8.5.1 allows unauthenticated remote attackers to reset the administrator setup wizard and create rogue administrator accounts via the setup-restore endpoint. Actively exploited globally in targeted ransomware zero-day intrusions.
Vendor_Product: Atlassian Confluence Server and Data Center

Title: HTTP/2 Rapid Reset Protocol Level Distributed Denial of Service (CVE-2023-44487)
Raw_Content: Novel HTTP/2 stream multiplexing flaw (CVE-2023-44487). Attackers exploit the RST_STREAM frame to cancel requests immediately without waiting for server responses, causing rapid CPU exhaustion on perimeter web servers, load balancers, and reverse proxies without triggering standard rate limits.
Vendor_Product: HTTP/2 Web Servers and Reverse Proxies
Affected_Versions: HTTP/2 protocol implementations across Nginx, Apache, Envoy

Title: CVE-2023-41064 - Apple ImageIO BLASTPASS Zero-Click Arbitrary Code Execution
Raw_Content: CVE-2023-41064: Buffer overflow issue in Apple ImageIO across iOS before 16.6.1. Processing a maliciously crafted WebP image transmitted via iMessage allows arbitrary remote code execution on the mobile device without user interaction (zero-click). Disclosed by Citizen Lab as part of the BLASTPASS spyware exploit chain.

Title: CVE-2023-40118 - Android Settings Exported Intent Hijacking
Raw_Content: CVE-2023-40118: In Settings of Android 11, 12, 13, and 14, an exported activity lacks proper intent permission checks (CWE-926). A local mobile application without special permissions can launch arbitrary internal system settings dialogs and bypass user consent verification.

Title: Frida 16.1.4 Release - Android ART Hooking and Jailbreak Detection Bypass
Raw_Content: Frida release 16.1.4 introduces low-level stalking updates for Android ART runtime and iOS 17 dyld shared cache hooking. Bypasses root detection and SSL certificate pinning in modern mobile banking applications.

Title: CVE-2023-35808 - D-Link DIR-846 Wireless Router OS Command Injection
Raw_Content: CVE-2023-35808: D-Link DIR-846 IoT wireless router firmware 100A52 contains a command injection flaw in the hedwig.cgi handler via the smartconnect parameter. Local or proximal attackers can execute arbitrary commands on the router hardware device.

Title: CVE-2023-34644 - Siemens SIMATIC S7-1500 PLC Industrial Modbus Denial of Service
Raw_Content: CVE-2023-34644: Siemens SIMATIC S7-1500 CPU programmable logic controller (PLC) industrial control firmware contains a memory corruption flaw during SCADA Modbus protocol packet parsing, causing operational hardware lockup.

Title: CVE-2023-41763 - HP Enterprise LaserJet Print Spooler Buffer Exhaustion
Raw_Content: CVE-2023-41763: In HP Enterprise LaserJet printer spooler firmware, malformed print job queue headers cause a denial of service condition in the print spooler daemon, requiring physical hardware reboot.

Title: CVE-2026-94138 - Chengdu Feiyuxing Router CGI Command Injection
Raw_Content: CVE-2026-94138: A security flaw in web management of Chengdu Feiyuxing Technology Feiyu Star Router. The file /send_order.cgi?parameter=del_expmac contains a command injection flaw via parameter 'mac'. Unauthenticated remote attackers can execute shell commands over HTTP. The vendor provided a low CVSS 2.0 placeholder rating despite full remote exploitability.
